label: prf:feynman-eigenbasis-decomposition
title: Proof of eigenbasis decomposition for the Feynman amplitude
html:
Proof. By the q-analogue of Schur--Weyl duality (knot eigenbasis completeness(1)), the tensor power decomposes as

  V^{\otimes n}
  \cong
  \bigoplus_{\substack{\lambda \vdash n \\ \ell(\lambda) \leq 2}}
  V_\lambda \otimes S_\lambda,

where V_\lambda is the irreducible \mathrm{SU}_q(2)-module of spin j = (\lambda_1 - \lambda_2)/2 and S_\lambda is the irreducible H_n(R, q)-module. The braid \beta \in B_n acts on V^{\otimes n} via the braid group representation \rho_n \colon B_n \to \mathrm{Aut}(V^{\otimes n}), and on each S_\lambda via the quotient map B_n \to H_n(R, q).

The number of summands is \lfloor n/2 \rfloor + 1, corresponding to spins j = n/2, n/2 - 1, \ldots, \epsilon/2 where \epsilon = n \bmod 2. This is finite for every n. \square
